title: Change the extension of many files
summary: rename every FILE.old of a directory to FILE.new, without destroying anything that is already there.
hints: Collect the names to change first (a growing array) and rename afterwards: renaming while you are reading the directory can make `readdir` show you a file twice.
`access(newpath, F_OK) == 0` tells you that the target already exists: skip that file, report it, and finish with status 1.
